title: EAT-MAN The Over Order New Anime Gets Spinoff Manga Series
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for EAT-MAN The Over Order , the new anime project for Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga, announced on Monday that Yoshitomi will launch a spinoff manga adaptation of the upcoming anime, titled Desert-Dessert From EAT-MAN The Over Order .
author: ANN

title: Manga Mavericks Books Licenses Gago Hunters Manga
content: Manga Mavericks Books , the publishing division of the Manga Mavericks website and podcast, announced on Monday during its online event that it has licensed Sho Yonoko's Gago Hunters: Greetings from Amatsumizu City's Gago Suppression Squad ( Amatsumizu-shi "Gago" Bokumetsu Dayori: Gagohan ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Use Its Coolest Saiyan Form Much More Often
content: The most hyped transformation in Dragon Ball history is rarely used, so there should be a resurgence of Super Saiyan 3 in the future. Goku shattered everyone’s minds by taking more than five minutes of screen time to grow his hair longer, lose his eyebrows and make electricity surround him.
author: ComicBook

title: Marco Kohinata's Akari Manga Wins French Prix Ouest-France Award
content: French comic festival Quai des Bulles awarded the French-language version of Marco Kohinata 's Akari manga the Prix Ouest-France award as part of its event this year. The story also won the ABCD Asia Award 2026 in July.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Continues to Break Records Weeks After Its Streaming Debut
content: While the animation studio hasn’t shared any updates on the second installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the first movie is still a major hit. The movie hit Japanese theatres in July last year and became a massive hit before its international premiere in September 2025.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Creator Saved Netflix’s Live-Action Series With Big Change During Production
content: It turns out One Piece creator Eiichiro Oda saved the production of Netflix’s live-action series adaptation with a major change to its budget and scripts as revealed by one of the showrunners behind it all.

title: Novelist Ryū Murakami Dies at 74
content: There was a private funeral for family members. Murakami was born in Nagasaki Prefecture in 1952. He made his debut with the novel Almost Transparent Blue , which sold more than 3.5 million copies.
